title: Do muscles grow on rest days? 🛌
caption:
Training is the signal; muscle building stays switched on for about 1-2 days after a hard session. Early on much of it goes to repair, then growth takes over. Rest days are building days, if you eat protein and sleep. Rest days: love or hate? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 18
first_comment: Rest day me: guilty for 24 hours straight 😅
